t2.thesis: Sentiment on CMG is washed out at a 52-week low, but the explicit Q3 comp-headwind warning, the salmonella episode and analyst reports of a slow Q4 start make a guidance cut likely enough that the setup is roughly a coin flip, slightly below the consumer base rate.
reasons: The stock is down 12% in a month and 32% over 12 months, sits at a 52-week low and has a forward P/E near 20, so expectations are already reset (I2, I8, I16, I25).
The 10-Q MD&A flagged low-single-digit comp headwinds into Q3 from food-safety concerns, and an 8-K disclosed a jalapeño salmonella issue that guidance excluded (I5, I7).
A long-standing bull downgraded on a slow Q4 start, which signals risk to the full-year guide; the October 2025 print fell 22% on a guidance cut (I21, I22, I2).
RBC flags comp upside, and the last two prints rose 7-9% on modest beats, so there is relief-rally potential (I13, I2).
Options price a ~7.5% move with call IV above put IV; put OI is heavy but concentrated in one strike, so options give no clear directional signal (I1, I2).
t2.deciding_variable: Whether management maintains the full-year low-single-digit comp guide and gives a Q4-to-date trend that is stable rather than deteriorating.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster consumer t0_hit 0.555 (n=436), cross-checked with by_session AMC 0.538 and overall ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report is dated 2026-10-28, which is after today (2026-10-27) and past my June 2026 knowledge cutoff, so the stock's reaction hasn't happened yet.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 3 points from 0.55. Guidance-cut risk (MD&A headwind warning, salmonella, the slow-Q4 downgrade, last October's -22% reaction) outweighs the contrarian support from the washed-out positioning, low valuation and RBC's upside call.

theses.mechanism: Q3 comp is in line or better and the FY guide is held; short-covering and value buyers lift a stock at its 52-week low.
theses.wrong_if: The FY comp guide is cut to flat or negative, or Q4-to-date comps are negative.

theses.mechanism: Salmonella and consumer headwinds push Q3 comps negative and the FY guide is lowered, repeating October 2025.
theses.wrong_if: The cut is smaller than the downgrade-implied fear, or buyback and margin commentary offsets it.

theses.mechanism: Mixed print: EPS in line, margin pressure from beef and labor, guide narrowed; the stock stays inside the implied move and the overnight drift from the entry open dominates.
theses.wrong_if: The guide is clearly raised or cut.

key_observations: Q3 comparable sales and transactions versus roughly flat-to-low expectations
Full-year comp guidance: held, narrowed or cut
Q4-to-date comp commentary on the call
Restaurant-level margin and beef/food cost inflation
